objects.name: Detection technique coverage: get-aduserresultantpasswordpolicy-with-powershell
objects.description: The following analytic detects the execution of `powershell.exe` running the `Get-ADUserResultantPasswordPolicy` cmdlet, which is used to obtain the password policy in a Windows domain. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names and command-line executions.
